text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her miraculous recovery, the 
name Yukoma Onsen rapidly drew widespread 
attention...!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oho, hot spring recuperation. It was great 
back in the day, but to think it's evolved 
this much. I should take the kids on my 
team for a nice refresh!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
It works on sprains too. Daily body care 
is essential, after all. Let's go check it 
out before it gets worse!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Everyone! A very warm welcome to you all!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Boy, it's busy. Not just our 
place, all the other inns must be in utter 
chaos too.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty, I'll organize the line~. Man, 
what crazy publicity though. That girl's 
seriously impressive.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If you're here for rehab, please sign your 
name on this roster~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
We will create the optimal recuperation 
plan tailored to your symptoms. Please 
feel free to share even the slightest 
concern.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
They examine them so thoroughly... Taking 
an approach different from a hospital to 
safeguard an Umamusume's health...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you too, you know~? They say 
people who try too hard lose track of just 
how tired they are!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If you want the girls you 
train to stay full of energy, you have to 
be healthy and full of energy first!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right, that makes sense. All 
right, I'll take this chance to get some 
proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot springs resort was overflowing 
with countless Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Refreshing, resting, and recovering from 
injuries. Every girl comes here for 
different reasons. Yet in the end, they 
all—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone! Thank you so much! My ankle's 
totally fine now! I'll give it my all at 
the academy again starting tomorrow~!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho... I am glad to hear that. It 
brings me great joy to have been of help.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Truly...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please come visit us anytime. Next time, 
preferably before you get injured.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
By the way, Landlady, it's already break 
time, you know? You've been like this all 
the time lately. Aren't you tired?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"You're a hundred years too early to be 
worrying about my health. I take perfect 
care of my own condition."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, my apologies for that.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Landlady. Everyone's leaving with 
a smile on their face, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, everyone's so full of energy. Full of 
energy, and healthy.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
This is the kinda view I always wanted to 
see...

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
――Aah, excuse me, Trainer over there. Is 
Hoshina-san's inn around here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As we speak, I notice the badge on his 
lapel. If I recall correctly, that's worn 
by high-ranking officials in the URA...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well...? You were here! And here I 
thought it was just a reservation with the 
same name."

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer Hoshina! Wait, no, you're the 
proprietress now! Brings back memories.

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
I came here partly for an inspection! I 
figured there are some things you only 
notice when you experience them as a 
guest.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we did receive an inquiry from the 
URA. They wanted their younger staff to 
tour our facilities.

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
"Headquarters is focusing on it again now. 
User numbers seemed to have dropped a few 
years ago, but if there's this much 
demand, that's a whole different story."

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Now that the business situation has 
completely recovered, we should increase 
subsidies and expand the facilities 
further—!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really...! Does that mean we don't 
have to shut down the inn?!

text_block_list.name: Dignified Man
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this place is crucial for the racing 
world! If you need anything, I'll arrange 
it for you. Just say the word!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that true? How truly grateful I am.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to make our baths even more 
fulfilling with the hot spring that you 
and the others dug out for us, <username>!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
We want to expand the sauna and rest 
areas, and hire more staff too...♪ Right, 
Proprietress?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! There's an endless amount of things 
needed for the Umamusume, after all.
